nodes.description: Public address state variable 'owner', initialized to msg.sender at deployment and used as the authorization reference in the restricted modifier.
Public uint state variable 'last_completed_migration' that records the last completed migration index; written by setCompleted.
Public function setCompleted(uint completed) guarded by the restricted modifier; the only externally callable state-changing entry point.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used both to initialize 'owner' and to perform the owner equality check in the restricted modifier.
Caller-supplied uint parameter 'completed' passed into setCompleted and assigned to last_completed_migration.
State write 'last_completed_migration = completed' reached only after the restricted modifier's msg.sender == owner require check passes.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read during construction and stored into the owner state variable, fixing the privileged address.
The restricted modifier's require(msg.sender == owner) gate on msg.sender controls whether the state write unsafe operation can execute.
The caller-supplied parameter 'completed' flows directly into the state write operation as the assigned value.
The result of the state write operation is stored into the last_completed_migration state variable.
The setCompleted function body contains and executes the restricted state write operation.

normalization_plan.reason: The non-core parameter 'completed' has no independent security semantics; it is fully consumed by the state write operation that assigns it to last_completed_migration.
